<div style="margin:0 5px">'''Floors''' are individual levels which contain specific [[Ores]]. Ores located on floors are always split by 80%/20% on initially occuring floor and 50%/50% on following floor. Currently there are 132 different floors, which are split thematically into different [[Floors#Zones|Zones]] and are a part of 4 different [[Floors#Floors_Select|Worlds]]. When unlocked by obtaning specific [[Floors#Floor_Upgrades|upgrades]] certain special variants of floors may spawn, such as Golden, Rainbow, Galactic, or Prismatic, which greatly increases the amount of ores obtained from them.
</div></div>

==Floor Upgrades==
Floor rewards can be improved by increasing related stats:
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Floor_Chance|Golden Floor Chance]] - Provides a chance to cause a floor to become a [[Floors#Golden_Floor|Golden]], providing multiplier to ores obtained on it
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Floor_Multiplier|Golden Floor Multiplier]] - Increases the multiplier for ores obtained on golden floors (base x5)
* [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Rainbow Floor Chance]] - Provides a chance to cause a floor to become a [[Floors#Rainbow_Floor|Rainbow]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Floor_Multiplier|Rainbow Floor Multiplier]] - Increases the multiplier for ores obtained on rainbow floors (base x50) 
* [[Stats#tabber-Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Galactic Rainbow Floor Chance]] - Provides a chance to cause a floor to become a [[Floors#Galactic_Rainbow_Floor|Galactic]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Multiplier|Galactic Rainbow Floor Multiplier]] - Increases the multiplier for ores obtained on galactic floors (base x10) 
* [[Stats#tabber-Prismatic_Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Prismatic Galactic Rainbow Floor Chance]] - Provides a chance to cause a floor to become a [[Floors#Prismatic_Floor|Prismatic]]
* [[Stats#tabber-Prismatic_Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Multi|Prismatic Galactic Rainbow Floor Multi]] - Increases the multiplier for ores obtained on galactic floors (base x1) 
* [[Stats#tabber-All_Floor_Multis|All Floor Multis]] - Further increases multipliers for all floor types

==Floor Types==
Floors have a chance to spawn as special floors, which multiply ores gained from mining ore nodes on that floor. Floors can have multiple special effects simultaneously, for example, a floor may spawn as a Golden Rainbow Floor. The ore gain multipliers from those modifiers stack multiplicatively, so with a Golden Floor Multiplier of 5x and a Rainbow Floor Multiplier of 50x, a Golden Rainbow Floor would multiply ore gain by 250x. These multipliers do not affect other resources like Veins.
===Golden Floor===
Golden Floors have a base ore gain multiplier of 5. They spawn entirely independently of other special floors. See sources of [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Floor_Chance|Golden Floor Chance]] and [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Floor_Multiplier|Golden Floor Multi]].

===Rainbow Floor===
Rainbow Floors have a base ore gain multiplier of 50. They spawn independently of Golden Floors, and are precursors to some other special floors. See sources of [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Rainbow Floor Chance]] and [[Stats#tabber-Rainbow_Floor_Multiplier|Rainbow Floor Multi]].

===Galactic Rainbow Floor===
Galactic Rainbow Floors have a base multiplier of 10. They have a chance to spawn when a Rainbow Floor spawns. The chance displayed in your Stats is the chance that a Galactic Rainbow Floor spawns ''if'' a Rainbow Floor has spawned. See sources of [[Stats#tabber-Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Galactic Rainbow Floor Chance]] and [[Stats#tabber-Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Multiplier|Galactic Rainbow Floor Multi]].

===Prismatic Galactic Rainbow Floor===
Prismatic Galactic Rainbow Floors have a base multiplier of 1 (no bonus). They have a chance to spawn when a Galactic Rainbow Floor spawns. The chance displayed in your Stats is the chance that a Prismatic Galactic Rainbow Floor spawns ''if'' a Galactic Rainbow Floor has spawned. See sources of [[Stats#tabber-Prismatic_Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Chance|Prismatic Floor Chance]] and [[Stats#tabber-Prismatic_Galactic_Rainbow_Floor_Multiplier|Prismatic Floor Multi]].

==Floor Clear Requirement==
You must clear a floor a certain number of times to be able to advance to the next floor. 
The Floor Clear Requirement in World 1 is Floor <math>\times</math> 5. If you're on floor 1 you need 5 clears to advance to floor 2. If you're on floor 42 you need 210 clears to advance to floor 43.<br>
The Floor Clear Requirement in World 2 is Floor <math>\times</math> 15. If you're on floor 43 you need 645 clears to advance to floor 44. If you're on floor 72 you need 1080 clears to advance to floor 73.<br>
The Floor Clear Requirement in World 3 is Floor <math>\times</math> 35. If you're on floor 73 you need 2555 clears to advance to floor 74. If you're on floor 101 you need 3535 clears to advance to floor 102.<br>
The Floor Clear Requirement in World 4 is Floor <math>\times</math> 105. If you're on floor 103 you need 10815 clears to advance to floor 104. If you're on floor 119, you need 12496 clears to advance to floor 120.

These are reduced by your {{Sprite|Floor Clear Requirement|Stats#tabber-Floor_Clear_Requirement|20}}.

==Drone Floor Clear Mechanics==
Drone floor-clearing speed is capped at 48 floors per minute.
The game checks once every 1 second whether a floor has been cleared, setting a theoretical maximum of 60 floors per minute. However, bombs and drones introduce a delay.
Bombs require 0.25 seconds to detonate and clear the screen. This delay reduces the effective rate, bringing the practical cap down to 48 floors per minute.

===Bear Drone Interaction===

There are frequent claims that the Bear Drone increases floor-clearing speed. This however is a highly contested topic and the answers are currently unclear.
